clauses.text: The wording excludes gradual pollution and wear and tear, subject to the stated exceptions.
Loss occurrences from the same event are grouped within a 72-hour period.
The limit includes one paid reinstatement.
The territorial scope is limited to the listed North Region territories.
No payment is due where payment would breach the illustrative sanctions wording.
The cedant should notify the reinsurer within 30 days after becoming aware of a claim.
